name: Oscietra Caviar & Smoked Bone Marrow
frenchName: Caviar Oscietra & Moelle Fumée à la Truffe
description: Royal Oscietra Caviar resting on charred Japanese brioche, slow-roasted bone marrow sabayon, fermented black truffle glaze, and sea buckthorn pearls.

winePairing.notes: Ethereal salinity with notes of toasted brioche and wild strawberries balancing the rich marrow.

name: Glacier Aged Wagyu A5 Ribeye
frenchName: Bœuf Wagyu A5 Maturé & Jus d'Ail Noir
description: Miyazaki A5 Wagyu sirloin dry-aged for 60 days over Himalayan salt blocks, black garlic reduce, smoked maitake jus, and crispy sunchoke ribbons.

winePairing.wineName: Château Margaux Premier Grand Cru Classé
winePairing.notes: Silky tannins and deep black currant aromatics elevating the marbling of A5 Wagyu.

name: Wild Atlantic Langoustine & Yuzu Emulsion
description: Pan-seared Scottish langoustine, confit fennel bulb, kaffir lime leaf oil, hand-harvested sea asparagus, and light dashi d'algues.

winePairing.notes: Crisp minerality and vibrant acidity echoing the shellfish sweetness.

name: Périgord Black Truffle Agnolotti
frenchName: Agnolotti à la Truffe Noire du Périgord
description: Handmade pillow pasta filled with 36-month Parmigiano-Reggiano cream, shaved fresh Périgord truffle, and roasted brown butter sage reduction.

winePairing.notes: Earthy rose and leather undertones complementing rich black truffle.

name: Fermented Heirloom Beetroot & Pine Infusion
frenchName: Betterave Héritage & Infusion de Pin Sauvage
description: Salt-crusted golden and candy beets, smoked almond ricotta, pickled elderberry vinegar, and wild Douglas fir needle broth.

winePairing.notes: Flinty herbaceous minerality harmonizing with botanical pine notes.

name: The Obsidian Gold Sphere
description: Dark Valrhona 85% Guanaja chocolate shell, passionfruit liquid gold heart, hazelnut praline crunch, and warm Tahitian vanilla bean reduction.

winePairing.notes: Honeyed apricot and citrus peel slicing through deep dark cacao.
